in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who rules over twice born (brahmins)

in_marathi.name: Dwijaraj
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dwijaraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Dwijaraj is derived from the Sanskrit words 'dwija' meaning 'twice born' and 'raja' meaning 'king'. In Hindu mythology, the term 'dwija' is used to refer to individuals who have undergone a sacred ritual known as 'Upanayana', which symbolizes their transformation into a twice-born being. The name is thus a reflection of one's spiritual growth and royal status.
